method: Assistant opened and visually inspected each of the eight actual final PNG files; automated layout probes are separate.

images.observation: 浅色合同草稿继承官网蓝色标识、暖白画布、细线表单、原分类和文字恢复说明；无可见重叠。
深色合同草稿的画布、面板、输入、正文及提示均使用深色令牌，未残留浅色输入背景。
深色采购表单以单列分段呈现，负责人双操作按钮可见，沿用官网标识与间距。
浅色报销表单使用同一业务视觉层级，项目、分类和负责人清晰，未新增模块专属颜色。
浅色送审区实际显示固定计划、制度、独立审批人、自审和撤回政策；核对框初始未勾选，按钮禁用。
深色送审区显示相同固定制度及未勾选确认，文字与细线面板可辨识，按钮状态明确。
报销显示中文“尚未送审”，费用合计 HKD15.700000 与其中员工垫付 HKD10.500000 分列，未混作付款。
历史区实际显示四条修订，第一修订展开，明确标记“当时”内容，原用途与后续修改用途不同。

fixed_during_review: not_submitted now displays 尚未送审; final browser explicitly verifies this label
Preview and history captures now show their actual target region rather than the top of the current request

inherited_open_findings.description: The fixed-content byte display rounds a one-byte-over-limit value; this OA increment does not close that reader issue.
Extreme English titles can place the brand dot on its own line; this OA increment does not close that shared typography issue.

limitations: Screenshots capture only the actual visible region of Taro internal scrolling, not every field in the long form.
Full read-screen, native keyboard, safe areas, dynamic system font sizes and mini-program/Android devices were not exercised.
Fixture data is fictional, file bytes are small and controlled, and no real cloud/production/model/TG operation was performed.
